project_type: Electron + Lit web components app - stealth AI overlay for interviews
language: JavaScript (CommonJS for main process, ES modules for renderer)
build_command: Cannot build (no npm/electron available in sandbox)
test_command: Cannot test (no npm/electron available in sandbox)
verification_instructions: AST validation via node -c on JS files. Grep for syntax patterns. Manual code review.
setup_instructions: npm install && npm start (not available in sandbox)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm, no package installs. Validation only via syntax checking and code review. Lit loaded from bundled assets (../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js). No React - this is all Lit.
contribution_requirements: Run prettier before committing. Commit style: feat/fix/refactor/chore prefixes. Keep existing functionality working. Don't restructure typing system. Don't touch window movement/transparency.

key_patterns.main_process: CommonJS (require/module.exports). Main entry: src/index.js. Storage: src/storage.js (file-based JSON with in-memory cache). IPC handlers defined in setupXxxIpcHandlers() functions in index.js.
key_patterns.renderer: src/utils/renderer.js is loaded as a preload-style script (nodeIntegration: true). Exposes global 'cheatingDaddy' object with sub-objects: .storage, .window, .typing, .apiKeys, .debug. Also _eventBus (EventTarget) for cross-component events. Uses window.require for electron.
key_patterns.components: Lit web components in src/components/. Views in views/, UI primitives in ui/. App shell: CheatingDaddyApp.js. Each component imports lit from bundled asset.
key_patterns.stores: src/stores/ - Store base class (ES module). settings-store, session-store, typing-store, ui-store, window-store. Only session-store is subscribed to from CheatingDaddyApp. settings-store auto-inits on import.
key_patterns.services: src/services/ - HotkeyService (used in window.js), StorageService (unused), SessionService (unused). All CommonJS.
key_patterns.typing: src/typing/ - Full 12-backend typing system. TypingManager is instantiated in index.js. IPC handlers wire it up. Renderer dispatches events for typing state.

directory_structure: src/ - main source. src/assets/ - bundled libs + icons. src/components/app/ - app shell. src/components/views/ - page views. src/components/ui/ - reusable UI primitives. src/stores/ - reactive stores. src/services/ - main-process services. src/typing/ - typing injection system. src/utils/ - renderer.js, gemini.js, window.js, prompts.js, etc.
